corrections: Dedicated C forebody, single-seat canopy and bow, ventral twin oval intakes, narrowed lower engine-body sections, delta wing, separate canards, swept elevons, single fin and paired petal nozzles replace the shared prototype.
B three-view used only for shared airframe features; C photo separately checked. Prototype drawing excluded because its dimensions disagree with production aircraft.
Cockpit has a recessed and inclined central HLD, two lateral touch displays, lower keypad, wide combiner, right side-stick, left twin throttles and a reclined F16F-style seat with harness.
Pilot-eye checks corrected the HLD casing gap and relocated the HUD projector forward so it clears the central display while remaining beneath the windscreen.

Live attitude, true heading, true airspeed, geometric altitude and vertical-speed pages use common model.signals expressions. Missing values blank; signed altitude is preserved. Swept elevons use fixed physical hinge axes and combine pitch/roll.
reviewNotes.independentDimensions: Manufacturer envelope: length 15.30m, span 10.90m, height 5.30m. Exterior overlays use uniform scales from independent span/length. Cockpit photo has no verified physical dimensions; its scale is explicitly provisional.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected four drawing/photo-edge overlays, the separate C photo overlay, eight standard views and twelve detailed cockpit/control/exterior states at source dbe48a0e1d328e57af6120615a9726dc9c3b1dd4d9d7b38b48d38ea71418f798. Verified unobstructed HLD, recessed screens, canopy/HUD clearance, open intake/nozzle mouths, missing-data blanking, negative altitude and opposite control deflections.
limitations: Shared-airframe illustrator three-view is Rafale B; C canopy is checked against an oblique photograph. The latter cannot certify dimensions, cross-sections or perspective-dependent tail alignment.

Fox Three cockpit photograph is small and from an early installation. Display sizes, coaming depth, console switches and seat placement are approximations; no production-block or engineering-drawing accuracy is claimed.
HLD and lateral screens show labeled simulator flight pages, without optical collimation or authentic mission software. Engine, fuel and sensor values remain unavailable rather than invented.

TAS and geometric altitude are labeled; pitot/static instruments, radar, fuel/electrical systems and Rafale flight-control laws are not simulated. Gear retraction and control scheduling remain simplified.
Selected panel boundaries, fasteners and markings are modeled; full maintenance-level skin details, exact intake curvature, inner engine machinery and all cockpit switch functions remain simplified.

cockpitSweep.finding: The seat stood 0.91 m behind the eye. The panel wings, standby horizon, hood and tub walls stood outside the skin.
changes: Seat forward 0.61 m and up 0.23 m, keeping its 29 degree recline; stick and throttles forward 0.25 m; armrests forward 0.28 m.
Panel wings narrowed from 0.48 to 0.43 m half-width, standby horizon moved inboard 0.045 m, side keys moved inboard, hood tapered, tub walls, floor and footwell drawn inside the skin.
limitations: Seat, stick, pedal and throttle positions come from seated-eye ergonomic targets and cockpit photographs, not a dimensioned installation drawing.
On this reclined seat the straight seatback and cushion rays read low by geometry: 0.18 and 0.62 m correspond to an eye 0.30 m clear of the back along its normal.
The dial reading is the display heading rose, not a round instrument.
